name: STI Electronics, Inc.
old_description: STI Electronics, Inc. is a leading provider of comprehensive solder and electronic assembly training, designed to enhance skills and meet the stringent requirements of the industry.
about:
STI Electronics, Inc. was founded in 1982 by Jim D. Raby, P.E., in San Dimas, California. The family-run business relocated to Madison, Alabama, in 1993 and has since grown to over fifty professionals. Raby brought more than 55 years of industry experience, including a pivotal role in developing NASA and Department of Defense soldering schools.

The company provides contract electronic manufacturing, engineering and design services, rapid prototyping, new product introduction (NPI) builds, PCB assembly, rework and repair, advanced testing, and conformal coating. It operates analytical laboratories for materials testing and failure analysis, cleanroom manufacturing, and an IPC-authorized training center offering courses such as J-STD-001, IPC/WHMA-A-620, and IPC 7711/7721 at facilities in Madison, Alabama, and Houston, Texas, as well as online.

STI serves safety-critical, mission-critical, and military-grade applications across aerospace, defense, medical, industrial, and energy markets. Customers include organizations requiring high-reliability cable and wire harness assemblies, PCB assemblies, and specialized engineering support for low-to-medium volume, high-complexity programs.

The company emphasizes engineering-driven manufacturing where precision, reliability, and quality are essential. Its differentiator is the integration of advanced manufacturing, engineering services, analytical laboratories, and one of the industry’s most respected electronics training and certification programs under one roof, enabling customers to reduce risk and solve complex manufacturing challenges.
